title: Beautiful experience
text: This was a beautiful experience and a great way to see Barcelona. The ride was smooth, the jazz was beautiful, and the the views were spectacular. Overall wonderful experience.
author: Imani_R

title: A beautiful experience
text: This was such a lovely relaxing evening on the water with some great musicians! I would say a great experience for a great price! Being on the Mediterrean was wonderful!
author: Rindi_S

title: Chilled Catamaran in beautiful Barcelona
text:
Chilled time on beautiful Catamaran. Sail away with jazz playing… just perfect. 
Would highly recommend and did not want to get off 🤣😎
author: Jacqueline_W

title: Awesome experience, jazz...
text: Awesome experience, jazz is very well played unfortunately I forgot to ask the name of the artist. We enjoyed the trip .
author: neelam_k

title: Amazing experience
text: it was probably the best thing i did in barcelona on my own. Great vibes to relax to. Great music, with a great drink and great people to talk to.
author: Tyrese_F

title: Absolutely beautiful. Had...
text: Absolutely beautiful. Had a pitcher of Sangria and laid on the netting suspended over the water. A great time and definitely worth the price.
author: Logan_S

title: Relaxing and chill experience!
text: Super relaxing and chill experience. There was a saxophone and bass guitar player and they were amazing. The temperature was just right and it wasn't too hot or cold. The views of Barcelona from the water were amazing. You could purchase snacks and beverages from the catamaran and they were reasonable. Perfect way to end the day on a sailing jazz experience.
author: TinaMarie_D

title: Highly recommended
text:
Great jazz music and lovely sail . 
2 hour ride is a good relaxed getaway from the hustle of the city.
author: vivek_s

title: Relaxed jazz vibe.
text: What a wonderful and relaxing way to spend the afternoon. The musicians were very talented and the music sounded great. The drinks were good and so was the overall vibe. After a full day of sightseeing, this was a perfect break. I enjoyed seeing the city from the boat. Would recommend.
author: Wanda_T
